results.comment: 38:17 This is fascinating and I agree with most everything she says. However I strongly disagree that you cannot "fake confidence". I am constantly faking confidence, but it is a learned action from observing social situations. I have high self-esteem but not always high self-confidence. I've learned if you walk into a room faking-acting confidently with a certain demeanor, even if you are anxious and fearful, people will not realize you are anxious and fearful. I found this happening at crowded bars where as a tall guy I always felt like people were staring at me. As long as I look cool and confident then people will have no idea that I'm actually on the verge of a panic attack. The longer you fake the confidence it eventually becomes actual confidence because everyone around you respects you as a confident person. It resets every time but the point is you can definitely 100% fake confidence because I've been doing it my whole life. She has amazing advice but there's still that minor aspect of being a 6'4 man in his 40s that she'll never fully be able to relate to.
